invariants.rationale: If the stage exists, its camera should also be accessible immediately after retrieval.
Stage width is expected to be non-negative whenever a stage exists.
Stage height is also expected to be non-negative if a stage instance is present.
A valid Stage is expected to have a non-null root actor.
If a Stage is present, it should have a valid Camera. (Semantic duplicate of invariant 1, included only for demonstration.)
